final: WITH g AS (SELECT p.fundflux AS src, AVG(s.boxy / s.boxz) AS yz, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM scanspatial s JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux), a AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avgcnt FROM g), k AS (SELECT g.src, g.yz, g.cnt, a.avgcnt FROM g CROSS JOIN a WHERE a.avgcnt IS NOT NULL AND g.cnt > a.avgcnt) SELECT AVG(yz) AS avg_yz_ratio, SUM(cnt) AS total_count, AVG(cnt - avgcnt) AS avg_count_diff FROM k
